Name: Craft From World Chests
Author: 1A2B3C4DABCD
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Craft from anywhere as long as you have the materials in your chests! [/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]You can customize the settings via the Generic Mod Config Menu or by editing the `config.json` file in the `DustSpiritFloors` folder. [/color]

[b]Range[/b]
[list]
[*]Nearby: nearby chests.[/*]
[*]SameMap: current map.[/*]
[*]World: entire world.[/*]
[/list][b]Nearby Radius[/b]: Only used when Range is Nearby

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Unzip the file and put the [b]CraftFromWorldChests[/b] folder inside the [b]Stardew Valley\Mods[/b] folder.
Requires SMAPI 4.0+[/color]
